accepted_sample.concept: Hyperthyroidism in pregnancy – antithyroid drug choice

Distractor 'Apply the adult NEWS2 pathway because she is not pregnant' partially endorses the same NEWS2 approach as the key. It is less complete, but still true enough to weaken single-best-answer integrity and cue the fuller option.

highest_leverage_defect: Upstream generation remains non-compliant with already-hardened evidence contracts: named-score arithmetic is repeatedly regenerated, state/timing anchors are omitted, and partial-truth distractors can still overlap the key. The numerical gate is now correctly fail-closed, so the next leverage is generation precision rather than relaxing rejection.
fix_applied: Run-41 eval-only generation/evidence repair: added a general partial-truth distractor prohibition; a literal named-score arithmetic self-check; stricter first-exposure and shock-state anchoring; a no-overlap rule for NEWS2 sepsis risk distractors; a safer CURB-65 interpretation blueprint; preference for score-free sepsis fluid targets when appropriate; and a complete-strategy rather than timing-only paediatric DKA fluid blueprint. No safety, source, ambiguity, numerical or SBA gate was weakened.
